name: Bolts, screws and fasteners
summary: Bolts, nuts, screws, nails, rivets and threaded rod: the things that hold every build together.
uses: Threaded rod for clamps and presses
identify: Every machine is a fastener store: furniture, bed frames, shelving, playgrounds and vehicles give good bolts, and hardware stores and workshops hold sorted bins. Marks on bolt heads show strength: radial lines on inch bolts, 8.8 or 10.9 on metric.
test: Run a nut along the thread by hand to check it. Reject bent, stretched (thinned waist) or badly rusted bolts for anything that carries load.

decay.note: Lasts. Rusty threads clean up with oil and a wire brush.
